cards.text: Roar: remove an adjacent animal of strength 4 or less. If it was yours, play another animal.

cards.name: Ember
cards.text: Flight. When this is removed, shuffle it into your deck.
When one of your animals is covered, remove it and draw a card.

cards.name: Praying Mantis
cards.text: Roar: remove an adjacent friendly animal to draw 2 cards.

cards.name: Tarantula
cards.text: Dusk: at random, remove your adjacent friendly animal and gain its strength.

cards.name: Sea Turtle
cards.text: Dusk: place a Baby Turtle on an adjacent empty crossroad.

cards.name: Raccoon
cards.text: Roar: return an animal from your Remove Pile to your hand.

cards.name: Piranha
cards.text: Roar: if one of your animals was removed this turn, remove an adjacent enemy.

cards.name: Hyena
cards.text: Dusk: gain 3 food for each of your animals removed this turn.

cards.name: Vulture
cards.text: Flight. Dusk: if one of your animals was removed this turn, draw a card.

cards.name: City Spider
cards.text: When an animal of strength 2 or less is placed next to this, remove it.

cards.name: Earthworm
cards.text: When this is removed, place two Worms on its crossroad.

cards.name: Cockroach
cards.text: When this is removed, put it back in your hand and draw a card.
